titleText.es: He sees you when you're sleeping, he knows when you're awake, he's copied on /var/spool/mail/root, so be good for goodness' sake.
titleText.en: He sees you when you're sleeping, he knows when you're awake, he's copied on /var/spool/mail/root, so be good for goodness' sake.
titleText.noteEn: The Spanish archive keeps the official English title attribute unchanged. Terminal prompts, commands, the English password prompt, the sudoers filename, and the command name SUDO are audited non-Spanish technical exclusions. The black cursor, list entries beneath BUENOS and MALOS, underlines, screen, figures, and speech tails are structural artwork rather than additional printed lexical text. OCR split the printed wrap INCIDEN-/TES; it is authored as one Spanish word while leaving the wrap hyphen and quotation marks outside its hotspot.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Archivo can mean a physical archive or a computer file. In computing, it is a named collection of stored data.

example.es: Guardé el informe en un archivo nuevo.
example.en: I saved the report in a new file.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: An incidente is an event or problem, especially one that is unusual or requires attention.
Incidentes is the plural of incidente.
Reportado is the masculine singular participle of reportar. With a form of ser, it can describe something that is or will be reported.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: to (introduces the person who receives information)
cardDefinitions.noteEn: After informar, a can introduce the person who is told or receives the report.

example.en: They informed the director of the change.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Informa is a present-tense form of informar for él, ella, usted, or one named thing. The people who receive the information can follow with a.

example.es: La oficina informa a los clientes del retraso.
example.en: The office informs the clients of the delay.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: of; about (introduces what someone is informed of)
cardDefinitions.noteEn: With informar, de can introduce the event, fact, or subject being reported.

example.en: She informed us of the problem.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Mirado is the participle of mirar. With haber, it says that someone has looked at or checked something.

example.es: He mirado el registro esta mañana.
example.en: I checked the log this morning.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: the good ones; good people (masculine or mixed plural)
cardDefinitions.noteEn: A plural adjective can stand alone when the omitted people or things are understood. Buenos can therefore label the good members of a masculine or mixed group.

example.es: Separaron a los buenos de los malos.
example.en: They separated the good ones from the bad ones.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: the bad ones; bad people (masculine or mixed plural)
cardDefinitions.noteEn: A plural adjective can stand alone when the omitted people or things are understood. Malos can therefore label the bad members of a masculine or mixed group.

example.es: En el cuento, los malos pierden al final.
example.en: In the story, the bad people lose in the end.

cardDefinitions.questionEn: How do you say that one person or organization informs someone of something?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: Use a matching form of informar, then a + the recipient, and de + the information or event.
cardDefinitions.noteEn: The a-part answers who receives the information. The de-part answers what that person is informed of. The order may move in a question, but both links keep the same roles.

example.es: La agencia informó a Marta del incidente.
example.en: The agency informed Marta of the incident.

cardDefinitions.promptEs: incidente · reportado · informa · mirado · buenos · malos
cardDefinitions.questionEn: Why does the final list reveal the joke's answer to the question about sudo reports?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: The computer warning says an incident will be reported, and Santa is shown maintaining the lists of good and bad people.
cardDefinitions.noteEn: The familiar sudo warning threatens that an unauthorized attempt will be reported. The title text parodies the English song about Santa knowing who is sleeping or awake and being good, then adds the Unix mail path /var/spool/mail/root. The final panel therefore implies that Santa receives the incident reports and uses them for his good-and-bad lists.
